T0534.title: Build Signing
T0534.definition: A mechanism that cryptographically signs build artifacts so consumers can verify origin and integrity.
T0534.description: Build signing lets consumers verify that an artifact came from a trusted pipeline and was not modified after build. It is usually paired with key management, provenance attestations, repository policy, and deployment admission. Reviews should examine signing-key protection, what is covered by the signature, whether verification is mandatory, and rollback behavior.
T0534.usageExample: Assess Build Signing related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
